body.statement: In the special case \(K=2\), \(\mathcal H_0=\{(0,0),(1,0),(0,1)\}\), \(w_1=w_2=1/2\), and \(n=1\), symmetry yields \(V_1=\overline\Phi(\log 39-1/2)/4\).
body.justification: The exact reduction checks normalization, closure, oracle subtraction, and least-favorable symmetry in the smallest nontrivial instance.
body.gap: This is a sanity reduction rather than a novelty claim; it anchors the general frontier to an exactly solvable Gaussian case.
body.consumer: It provides a unit test for any implementation of the finite Bellman recursion and certificate.
